question: An 85,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 4x between x = 2 and x = 4. Six identical drives each supply the force needed for this, and the controller sums the 6 outputs. It adds 15 N of belt tension and converts the total to kN. The conveyor runs at 40 °C. A 9 kN structural allowance is then added. What is the final value, in kN?

The total in a projectile-range report, in kJ, is 10 times a daily figure. The daily figure is 5 times a volley figure expressed in kJ. The volley figure is the combined energy of motion of 3 identical projectiles. Each projectile has a mass of 12 kg and flies at a speed in m/s equal to 4 times the sum of 7 and 5. The range is 900 m long. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

A cyclist and bike with a combined mass of 48 kg ride on a velodrome at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. A team of 8 such riders has a combined energy of motion 8 times that of one rider, and the coach converts that combined value to kJ. Three teams compete, so the meet figure is 3 times the team figure. Finally 23 kJ of stored reserve is added. What is the final figure, in kJ?

The final energy figure in a test log, in J, is 22 J of stored spring energy added to an adjusted value. The adjusted value is 20 J of sensor offset added to the energy of motion of a 20 kg sled. The sled moves at a speed in m/s equal to 18 less than the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 13. The sled track is 250 m long. What is the final figure, in J?

The value a technician finally records, in kJ, is 16 kJ less than a subtotal. The subtotal is 25 kJ of battery reserve added to the energy of motion of a 10 kg cart, after that energy has been converted to kJ. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to 7 times the greatest common divisor of 351 and 373. The cart's wheels are 12 cm in diameter. What value does the technician record, in kJ?

The number at the bottom of a rail-depot energy sheet, in J, is 29 J less than a daily total. The daily total is 10 times a per-run figure. The per-run figure is 3 J less than the combined energy of motion of 5 identical trolleys. Each trolley has a mass of 17 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 4x² at the point x = 1. What number is at the bottom of the sheet, in J?

A 104,000 g block on a test rig is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 4x² + 5x between x = 0 and x = 2. The force needed for this, less 9 N supplied by a spring, is the actuator force. The actuator force is converted to kN. The rig log then records the actuator force minus a 30 kN clamping load, with the actuator direction positive, so the entry may be negative. What does the log record, in kN?

The final line of a press-test sheet is a net force in kN, found by subtracting 30 kN of return-spring load from an earlier net figure, with the pressing direction taken as positive. That earlier figure was a combined ram force with 24 kN of frame resistance subtracted. The combined ram force, expressed in kN, is that of 5 identical rams acting together. Each ram supplies the force needed to accelerate a 40 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to 5 times the sum of 8 and 8. What net force is on the final line, in kN?

The final value on a drone-motor test sheet is a thrust expressed in kN. It is obtained by converting to kN a force that was built up as follows: 24 N of margin was added to a subtotal, and that subtotal was 15 N of gust allowance added to a net thrust. The net thrust was the force needed to accelerate a 5 kg drone at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 8, less 29 N of lift contributed by ground effect. What is the final value, in kN?

A 92,000 g sled on a rocket track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the greatest common divisor of 70 and 343. The thrust required for this is supplied by each of 11 identical boosters, and the range sums the 11 outputs. From that sum, 19 N of rail friction is subtracted. Then 11 N of air drag is subtracted. What is the resulting thrust, in N?

A 164,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 9. The drive must supply the force for this, plus 8 N of roller friction, plus a further 17 N of belt tension. A 4 N assist from a slight downward incline is then subtracted. What force must the drive supply, in N?

The total in a delivery-fleet energy report, in J, is 7 times a weekly figure. The weekly figure is 3 times a daily figure. The daily figure is 3 J more than the combined energy of motion of 4 identical cargo trikes. Each trike has a mass of 39 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 1·x² at the point x = 2. What is the total in the report, in J?

A 195,000 g beam on a construction hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The hoisting force needed for this is converted to kN. Nine such hoists lift together, so the combined figure is 9 times that value. A 25 kN dead-load allowance is added, and then 16 kN of counterweight assist is subtracted. What is the final figure, in kN?

The figure a test engineer finally quotes, in kN, is 6 kN of margin added to a combined force that is expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 4 identical thrusters acting together. Each thruster supplies the force needed to accelerate a 164,000 g sled at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 12. What figure does the engineer quote, in kN?

The final entry in a launcher log is a net force in kN, defined as a combined thrust expressed in kN minus a 6 kN restraint load, with the launch direction positive, so it may be negative. The combined thrust is that of 9 identical launchers. Each launcher supplies the force needed to accelerate a 12,000 g projectile at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 10, less 23 N that a spring contributes. What is the final entry, in kN?

A 118 kg tool carriage is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the sum of 7 and 2. The force required for this is converted to kN. The carriage rail is 9 m long. A 13 kN structural allowance is added, and then 3 kN of counterweight assist is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in kN?

A 36 kg robot chassis on a factory floor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The floor is 60 m long. There are 10 robots per cell and 10 cells, so the factory figure is the per-robot value multiplied by 10 and then by 10 again. What is the factory figure, in kN?

A 15,000 g tool head on a milling machine is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 15 more than the area under y = 1·x² + 6x between x = 3 and x = 4. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The machine log records a net force defined as that value minus a 19 kN clamping load plus a 15 kN hydraulic assist, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?

A cyclist and bike with a combined mass of 55,000 g ride at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 riders from a squad of 8. A team of 8 such riders has a combined energy of motion 8 times that of one rider. Four teams race, so the race figure is 4 times the team figure. From the race figure, 13 J of timing-gate loss is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in J?

The last line of a sled-test log is a net force in kN, obtained by subtracting 13 kN of drag-chute load from an earlier figure, with the thrust direction positive, so it may be negative. That earlier figure was a thrust expressed in kN with 19 kN of rail-brake load subtracted. The thrust is the force needed to accelerate a 119 kg sled at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 2x² + 8x between x = 3 and x = 4. The track is 1.2 km long. What net force is on the last line, in kN?

The figure at the bottom of a crane load sheet, in kN, is 9 kN of wind allowance added to a three-hoist total. The three-hoist total is 3 times a single-hoist net force expressed in kN. The single-hoist net force is 19 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 134 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 0x between x = 0 and x = 4. What figure is at the bottom of the load sheet, in kN?

The total in a shipyard's winch report, in N, is 5 times a dock total. The dock total is 10 times a bay total, and the bay total is 7 times a single-winch pull. A single winch supplies the force needed to accelerate a 66 kg anchor block at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 4x² + 6x between x = 1 and x = 2. The winch cable is 30 m long. What is the total in the report, in N?

The total on a dockside crane's load sheet, in kN, is 6 times a per-crane figure. The per-crane figure is 5 kN of wind allowance added to a six-cable total. The six-cable total is 6 times a single-cable force expressed in kN. The single-cable force is what is needed to accelerate a 182,000 g hook block at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. What is the total on the load sheet, in kN?

The final figure in a drone-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 15 kJ of reserve added to a fleet total. The fleet total is 11 times a per-drone figure. The per-drone figure is 20 kJ of battery reserve added to the energy of motion of one drone, after that energy has been expressed in kJ. Each drone has a mass of 14 kg and flies at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ + 4x² at the point x = 2. The drones operate at an altitude of 120 m. What is the final figure, in kJ?

A 33,000 g projectile is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the larger root of x² - 10x + 16 = 0. The launcher must supply the force for this plus 3 N of guide friction. The launcher barrel is 2.5 m long. Nine launchers fire together, so the combined force is 9 times the single-launcher value, and the combined force is converted to kN. What is the combined force, in kN?
